# worldmap.tech

> worldmap.tech is a free web app for marking the countries you've visited on a zoomable world map. It shows how many countries you've been to, what percentage of the world that is (out of 195) and a traveller level, and lets you save a shareable image or compare maps with a friend. No sign-up required; available in English and Turkish.

Key facts:

- Tap a country to mark it as visited (it turns soft blue); tap again to remove it. A search box (top right) finds and highlights a country, which can be marked from the results.
- World % = visited count / 195 (the 193 UN member states plus Vatican City and Palestine). 233 places are selectable in total, so the count can exceed 195.
- A traveller level title appears at 1, 5, 10, 20, 35, 60 and 100 countries.
- Save generates an image on the device in Story (1080×1920), Square (1080×1080) or Wide (1920×1080) format, showing count, level, world %, flags of visited countries (taller formats) and an optional QR code linking to the map.
- Share link: the map is encoded in the URL (worldmap.tech/#w…). Opening a friend's link shows both maps compared: the friend in orange, you in blue, countries in common in purple.
- No account: the map is saved in the browser. It can be moved to another device via the share link or an anonymous 8-character restore code (no email); the code's data can be deleted.
- In-app browsers (Instagram, TikTok, etc.) keep separate storage; the app warns users about this.
- Borders and names follow the official positions of the Republic of Türkiye: e.g. Northern Cyprus (KKTC) is shown as a separate country, Crimea as part of Ukraine, the Golan Heights as part of Syria and Western Sahara as part of Morocco. Taiwan, Hong Kong and Macau can be marked separately.
- Free and ad-supported; ads never appear on the map or in saved images. Cookieless analytics; ad cookies only with consent where required.

- [worldmap.tech (Türkçe)](https://worldmap.tech/tr/): The same map app in Turkish.
